item.title: Rod Stewart Uses Oxygen Tank During Concert After Nearly Fainting Onstage
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: "Welcome back to 'Trending On', the podcast where we dive into the latest news and updates from the world of entertainment. I'm your host, [Name], and today we're talking about rock legend Rod Stewart. On Friday, June 19th, Stewart had to pause his concert in Utah after nearly fainting onstage. Yes, you heard that right - the 81-year-old singer was performing at the Utah First Credit Union Amphitheatre when he appeared visibly unwell and had to use an oxygen tank to assist with his breathing."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to eyewitnesses, Stewart was struggling to finish his hit song 'Young Turks' when he leaned against stage equipment and was given an oxygen tank by his team. But being the trooper he is, Stewart didn't let that stop him. He told the crowd he had nearly fainted, but insisted the 'show must go on'. And that's exactly what he did - finishing the concert while seated in a chair."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This incident comes just weeks after Stewart canceled a concert in San Diego due to health issues, citing an acute upper respiratory infection and laryngitis. And in a recent interview, Stewart hinted that his current One Last Time farewell tour might be his last major touring stint. He's got a few more dates lined up in the US, and then he's off to Las Vegas for a residency. We'll be keeping an eye on his schedule and wishing him all the best."
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in to 'Trending On'. If you want to stay up-to-date on the latest entertainment news, be sure to subscribe to our podcast and follow us on social media. Until next time, stay trendy!"
[Outro music continues to play as the episode ends]
